method: Local pinned SDK declarations and implementation; Maraca compiler and browser tests.

decisions: Host-invoked Maraca services explicitly declared in RMT data sources so generated manifests authorize them.
RMT background / after_paint scheduler used for favicon work; no invented XScaler image priority API.
Public XSurfaceManager and XSidePanel contracts used; no floating desktop windows.
Live data and editable form state separated; keyed source details prevent DOM draft reuse.
